title: Aurekai WeightOps Weight Trace
description: Output of `akai weights trace`. Identifies hot (always-needed) vs cold (never-accessed) tensor regions for a given recipe+model pairing.

hot_tensors.description: Tensor paths accessed on every inference for this recipe.

cold_tensors.description: Tensor paths never accessed — safe to skip.

lazy_regions.description: Capability regions that can be loaded on-demand after first usable checkpoint.
